{{Quote|It's not time for new business, Yemm.''"''<br />''"''But, Director!|Tol Sivron and Yemm during the Battle of the Maw|<ref name="CotF" />}}
'''Yemm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]]. He supervised and provided documentation and legal counsel over the [[Maw Installation]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I don't think we addressed that contingency either.|Yemm's response on how to rescue [[Wermyn]] on the Maw Istallation|<ref name="CotF" />}}
In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], he was head of the Maw Installation's [[Administration and Personal Resources Division]]. He was killed along with most of the scientists at [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] when [[Tol Sivron]] accidentally flew the [[Death Star prototype]] down a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] during the [[Battle of the Maw]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="CotF" />
